rows.note: For an electrical wire, 電線 is the all-purpose everyday choice.

example.english: This wire has come loose, so don’t touch it.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 din6 sin3 lat1 zo2 m4 hou2 dim3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for fitting electrical wires or connecting something to an electrical system.

example.english: The technician will wire the air conditioner for me.
example.jyutping: si1 fu6 bong1 ngo5 bok3 sin3 zong1 laang5 hei3

rows.note: Use this for wiring or remitting money, rather than for sending a message.

example.english: I wire money home every month.
example.traditional: 我每個月都匯錢返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 wui6 cin2 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this only for the old telecommunications sense of sending a message by telegram.

example.english: When he went abroad back then, he had to wire home to say he was safe.
example.traditional: 佢當年去外國，仲要發電報返屋企報平安。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dong1 nin4 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 zung6 jiu3 faat3 din6 bou3 faan1 uk1 kei2 bou3 ping4 on1

rows.note: Use 鐵絲 for generic thin metal wire or an individual piece of it.

example.english: Give me a piece of wire and I’ll tie the cardboard box securely.
example.traditional: 你畀我一條鐵絲，我綁實個紙箱。
example.jyutping: nei5 bei2 ngo5 jat1 tiu4 tit3 si1 ngo5 bong2 sat6 go3 zi2 soeng1

rows.note: Use this when fastening something with wire, such as repairing a hole in a fence.

example.english: The wire fence is broken, so I use wire to tie it back together.
example.traditional: 個鐵網爛咗，我用鐵線綁返好。
example.jyutping: go3 tit3 mong5 laan6 zo2 ngo5 jung6 tit3 sin3 bong2 faan1 hou2

rows.note: Use 鐵絲網 when the wire is being used as a fence or wire netting.

example.english: The construction site is fenced off with wire, so people aren’t allowed in.
example.traditional: 工地圍住咗鐵絲網，唔畀人行入去。
example.jyutping: gung1 dei6 wai4 zyu6 zo2 tit3 si1 mong5 m4 bei2 jan4 haang4 jap6 heoi3

rows.note: Use 電話線 specifically for a telephone or telecommunications line.

example.english: The telephone wire at home is broken, so I couldn’t make calls all night.
example.traditional: 屋企條電話線壞咗，成晚都打唔到電話。
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 tiu4 din6 waa6 sin3 waai6 zo2 seng4 maan5 dou1 daa2 m4 dou2 din6 waa6
